events.name: Bash
events.head: Check unpushed commits and setting usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline origin/main..main | head -20; echo ---; grep -n "delivery_whatsapp\|delivery_from\|tantra_whatsapp" cloud/src/*.ts | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "tantra_whatsapp\|delivery_whatsapp" app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read settings and delivery code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 60,100p cloud/src/settings.ts; echo ----; sed -n 100,190p cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts; echo ---; sed -n 280,340p cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin UI usage of delivery settings
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn "delivery_from\|delivery_email_via" cloud/src --include=*.ts --include=*.js --include=*.html | grep -v "jobs-delivery.ts" | head; grep -n "tantra_sender\|senderId\|function viaResend\|function fromRefused" cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts | head -20; ls cloud/migrations | tail -3

events.text: Adding a delivery-only WhatsApp account setting now, then the probe, deploy, and the live settings.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate admin form and helpers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln "delivery_from" cloud/src | head; grep -rn "delivery_from" cloud/src | grep -v jobs-delivery.ts | grep -v "settings.ts" | head -5; grep -n "function viaResend\|function fromRefused\|^const viaResend\|fromRefused =" cloud/src/*.ts | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find where tantra_whatsapp is shown
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln "tantra_whatsapp" cloud app/scripts --exclude-dir=node_modules 2>/dev/null | head; sed -n 60,70p cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect admin UI settings fields
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; diff -q cloud/public/admin/admin.js cloud/admin-ui/admin.js; grep -n "tantra_whatsapp\|delivery_from\|delivery_email_via" cloud/admin-ui/admin.js | head; grep -n "admin-ui" cloud/package.json cloud/wrangler.* 2>/dev/null | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find delivery section in admin UI
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "tantra_delivery\|resend_key\|Day output" cloud/admin-ui/admin.js | head; ls -la cloud/public/admin/admin.js cloud/admin-ui/admin.js; grep -n "admin-ui\|public/admin" cloud/scripts/*.* cloud/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read admin settings section
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 322,336p cloud/admin-ui/admin.js | cut -c1-400; grep -n "const KEYS\|SETTING_KEYS\|tantra_test_emails" cloud/admin-ui/admin.js cloud/src/index.ts cloud/src/settings.ts | head

events.text: Now the code edits: settings default, delivery helper, admin UI row.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Add delivery-only WhatsApp and sender settings

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fix status helper and check settings whitelist
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -i '' 's/    sender: (vr ? s.tantra_sender : senderOf(s)) || null,/    sender: (viaResend(s) ? s.tantra_sender : senderOf(s)) || null,/' cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts; grep -n "in DEFAULTS\|DEFAULTS)\|Object.keys(DEFAULTS\|validKey\|unknown setting" cloud/src/settings.ts cloud/src/index.ts | head

events.text: Good, settings PUT accepts any key in DEFAULTS. Now the admin UI row.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe head
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; wc -l app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs; sed -n 1,80p app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash

events.name: Bash

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check route prefixes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 795,800p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-200; sed -n 812,815p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-160; grep -n "tantra_campaigns\|tantra_nurture_campaigns\|followup" cloud/src/settings.ts | head

events.text: Extending probe-day-delivery so it proves the delivery-only WhatsApp account never reaches the reminder, lane or nurture campaigns.
